title: physics: stop open boundary at frozen reflection sign
science: First Stage-A gate stop on the open t=-12..11 D1 s=0 restriction: the frozen-sign degree-one Berezin form is exact rank two with inertia (0,22,2) and strictly negative diagonal, while the OPPOSITE global reflection sign obeys the same action covariance and is PSD rank two - so action covariance does not select the odd-field reflection sign; narrows the target to a sign/algebra/trace discriminator.
